function.arguments: {"observation": "The `assay_batch` column has two values: 'A' and 'B'. The data dictionary states that batch-B analyser reports in µg/L, not ng/mL, and that 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL, so batch-B `biomarker_final` values are 10× too large. They must be divided by 10 to be in ng/mL.", "implication": "The `biomarker_final` values are not all in the same units. To compute the mean in ng/mL, we must convert batch-B values by dividing by 10. Otherwise, the mean will be artificially inflated due to the batch-B unit error."}
function.name: note_finding
